item.title: v0.1.7
item.description: - Window previews in the Dock open and change faster and more smoothly as you move along the Dock. - The Dock no longer shows another app's name under a preview, also when you move quickly between apps or click an icon. - Window pictures are ready when a preview opens, so you no longer see the app's icon for a moment first. - Pointing at an app shows its window in place straight away, and it plays live, like the window under the pointer. - Click the app's icon to close the preview and go to the window you picked. You can stay on the icon, scroll to a window and click. - Scrolling on an app's icon now goes round its windows. It stops at the first and last window; scroll again after a short pause to go round. - Keys you type while a preview is open now reach the app you are using. - A preview no longer stays on the wrong app or closes by itself when you move slowly along the Dock. - Window pictures sit in the middle of their cards.
